messages:
samir: RFC follow-up: proposal to use lazy panel materialization + sampled aggregates to cut render cost. brief idea: head fetch returns sampled counts and top-k keys; exact only on drill.
jacob: how do we keep RBAC safe? lazy + sampling could leak rows if post-filtering is used.
priya: push predicates into storage. storage verifies signed predicate tokens and returns filtered streams. avoids large post-filter.
liz: UX: show an "estimated" badge, do exact query on hover/drill. product ok with this pattern.
jacob: ops: add singleflight at multiplexer for cold head_fetch to avoid thundering herd. head cache with soft-ttl and jitter.
priya: security: signed predicate tokens, short TTL, nonce, audit logs. add to RFC.
ops-bot: rollout: feature-flag "panel_lazy_v2". canary 5% tenants / 48h. monitor p50/p99 latency and RBAC audits.
samir: next steps: I will update RFC with token spec; jacob prototype singleflight; priya design storage plugin; liz mock UX. thanks :thumbsup:
